_comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 -> numeric-id lookup for world-atlas's countries-110m.json (Natural Earth numeric ids). Covers the countries named across the 30-day content-calendar.md lineup. A few lineup topics are NOT real sovereign countries in this dataset (Sealand, Bir Tawil, Null Island, Transnistria, Nagorno-Karabakh, the JSA/Panmunjom building, the old Saudi-Iraq Neutral Zone) -- for those, don't use `highlight`, instead place a marker/circle at the relevant lon/lat and/or draw a custom line, see README.
